title: Brent 5d surge leads corn 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Brent 5d cumulative log return > 5 pct leads corn futures higher by 3 days (+) via ethanol/input-cost channel; trade long ZC=F 5d [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.ZC=F.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ZC=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
